newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sing Tech units get nod to increase foreign stakes.
newsitem.headline: Sing Tech units get nod to increase foreign stakes.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Aerospace Ltd said on Monday it has obtained special member approval to raise its foreign share limit to 49 percent.

"As the company expands its business overseas, it anticipates that in the course of forging strategic alliances with partners overseas, it may need from time to time to raise funds or do a foreign share placement for strategic reasons," a company statement said.
In a separate statement, Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd said approval has also been given to increase foreign shareholding limit in its other subsidiaries to 49 percent.

These are Singapore Technologies Automotive Ltd, Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd, Singapore Technologies Shipping & Engineering Ltd, ST Computer Systems & Services Ltd and ST Electronic & Engineering Ltd.
The approval will provide flexibility to these companies to effect the foreign share limit as and when they deem fit.
ST Capital Ltd does not have a foreign share limit and will not be affected by this approval, Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd said.
